g.text: V8 ms/img = gen wall time incl. model+edit (750 tasks, batch 8, RTX 3060). External times from paper.tex; H2S/SG reproduced on the same 750 tasks, Speed = our measured runner on idle RTX 3060: H2S resident batch ~5 img/s (median 0.23 s/img, mean 0.36 s/img); SG official per-image subprocess mean 76.0 s over 19 tasks (SG fast-runner ~33 s/img not counted). V11B.* = wavelet stroke flow post-edit on LD4 outputs (RTX 4070); H2.t035 = 121 ms/img full-750 run, other V11B arms = steady-state 64-img probe (~62-172 ms/img by band/K). V11B.H2.t035.shuffle = wrong-style-id ablation. V15-local arms from docs/v15/v11b_arms.csv + v11b_speed.json. Cross600 dino_c .7770 / affinity .5666 — new combined-front point. WCT/SaMST dropped (DINO-C < 0.34).
